cohort: The study included 243,537 nulliparous women from the Swedish Pregnancy Register who delivered a singleton fetus at or after 34 gestational weeks between 2014 and 2020, excluding those with gestational diabetes.
finding: Women with pregestational diabetes experienced longer active labour and a reduced chance of vaginal delivery compared to non-diabetic women.
mod_finding: Women with pregestational diabetes had significantly higher rates of both elective and emergency caesarean sections, often indicated by suspected macrosomia and fetal distress.
